title: Sources Sought for Amplified Sound Masking System
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO TX.USPFO TX PROCUREMENT.W7N2 USPFO ACTIVITY TXANG 149
detail_text: **SOURCES SOUGHT** The 149th Fighter Wing is seeking to procure an ASP-MG2240 Amplified Sound Masking System or equal with installation at JBSA Lackland, San Antonio, Texas. If you have any questions or inquiries, please email Candace Fernandez at candace.fernandez@us.af.mil and Mark Green at mark.green.23@us.af.mil no later than (NLT) 13 May 2026 10:00 AM Central Daylight Time (CDT). All questions received after this time may not be answered or entertained. ------------------------------------------------------------------------- Please respond to the following questions: 1. Can your company provide the item and perform installation? 2. Are you a GSA vendor? If so, please provide your GSA Contract Number. 3. Please provide the name of your firm and contact information to include UEI number, email address, and physical address.
